entries.046b61d380dfb6a7: Its basic management philosophy is the spirit of “always learning, researching and creating.” Under its medium-term management plan for the period from the fiscal year ended March 2023 to the fiscal year ending March 2027, it states that, with “mechanization and automation of production processes,” “improvement of product quality,” “rebuilding the earnings base,” “management efficiency” and “human resource development” as its basic policies, it will commit management resources to growth fields and innovate production processes.
entries.10c9567ab2653e5d: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells signage products used on the interior and exterior of buildings. Mainly custom-made, one-off production to customer requests, with stainless steel as the main material. Manufacturing is carried out at the head office factory in Asakita Ward, Hiroshima City and at the Nakafukagawa Plant. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,411 million.
